description: Complete approval flow: start → progress → action → complete.

params.subject: Document review request
params.body: Please review and approve the attached.

notes: Multi-step vector. Process messages in order. Each message is either a request (has id) or notification (no id).

description: Sign flow requesting proof generation.
notes: The wallet should respond with a flow.complete containing the generated proof JWT.

description: OpenID4VCI completion (live) for an issuer response encrypted to a client-held key: credential_response_encrypted true, no credential values, no credential_metadata.
notes: The server relayed the issuer's JWE unread, so credentials[] entries carry no credential value and the completion carries no credential_metadata (auxiliary_data, if any, reached the client inside the JWE it decrypted itself). The client pairs credentials[0] with the first credential it decrypted; a count mismatch is an error. refresh_token, dpop_jwk and dpop_key_id are secrets: none is retained in any replay buffer. Values are test values.

description: OpenID4VCI deferred completion: plain issuer response, display-only credential_metadata, no credential_response_encrypted.
notes: Plain (unencrypted) response: credential_metadata carries only the display-only members (display, claims). credential_response_encrypted is absent, so credentials[] carry their values.

description: Replayed OpenID4VCI completion: refresh_token, dpop_jwk and dpop_key_id withheld, listed in redacted_members.
notes: Sent only from a replay buffer (Last-Event-ID or resume). The client must treat every listed member as not recoverable: no inferring that the issuer sent none, no inventing a refresh token or DPoP key; an issuance that required one is re-issued, and the credential cannot be renewed without re-issuance.

description: Negative: auxiliary_data in the credential_metadata of a plain (unencrypted) completion.
notes: auxiliary_data is never relayed in a completion. A server fails the issuance when a plain issuer response carries it and never emits this shape; a client that receives it MUST refuse the issuance and store nothing from it.

description: Negative: an encrypted-response completion that relays auxiliary_data in credential_metadata.
notes: With credential_response_encrypted true the server never relays credential_metadata, least of all auxiliary_data: it stays inside the JWE the client decrypts. A client MUST refuse this completion and store nothing from it.

description: Negative: an encrypted-response completion that carries credential_metadata at all (display-only).
notes: credential_metadata is never present when credential_response_encrypted is true; the client uses the response-level credential_metadata it decrypted.

description: Negative: an encrypted-response completion that carries a credential value.
notes: The server cannot read an encrypted response, so a credential value in this completion cannot come from the issuer; the client MUST refuse it.

description: Replayed completion where only refresh_token and dpop_key_id were present on the live one and are withheld.
notes: Only the members that were present are listed. The client must not invent a refresh_token; the credential cannot be renewed without re-issuance.

description: Sign flow requesting a key proof together with a client-held credential-response encryption key (proof_type and proof_types_supported present: proofs are requested).
notes: credential_response_encryption is additive and ignorable. The client generates a fresh ephemeral P-256 key, keeps the private key and returns the public JWK as credential_response_encryption_jwk in the sign result; absent or empty means declined, which fails the issuance when required is true.

description: Sign result of generate_proof carrying the client's public response-encryption JWK.
notes: Public coordinates only; the private key never leaves the client.

description: Sign flow requesting only the credential-response encryption key (no proof_type, no proof_types_supported).
notes: With credential_response_encryption and neither proof_type nor proof_types_supported the request is for the key alone: the client returns credential_response_encryption_jwk and no proofs.

description: Sign result of a key-only generate_proof: the public JWK and no proof.
notes: No proof_jwt: none was requested.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result that also returns the decrypted credentials.
notes: A decryption result carries control members only; sending credentials back would hand the orchestrator the plaintext it is meant not to see.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result that also returns credential_metadata.
notes: A decryption result carries control members only.

description: Sign flow asking the client to decrypt a relayed issuer JWE.
notes: The server cannot decrypt the value. The jwe here is a structurally valid test value, not decryptable.

description: Sign result of decrypt_credential_response for an immediate response: control members only.
notes: The client keeps the credentials and the response-level credential_metadata locally and reports only the count (1 to 256).

description: Sign result of decrypt_credential_response for a deferred response: transaction_id and interval.
notes: The server then polls the deferred endpoint; each answer goes through decrypt_credential_response again with deferred true.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result with both transaction_id and credential_count.
notes: Exactly one of transaction_id and credential_count; the server fails the issuance.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result with interval and no transaction_id.
notes: An interval belongs only to a deferred result and requires transaction_id.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result with credential_count and interval.
notes: An interval belongs only to a deferred result and requires transaction_id.

description: Negative: decrypt_credential_response result with credential_count 0.
notes: credential_count is 1 to 256; the server fails the issuance.

description: Sign flow for a direct_post.jwt request carrying the verifier's response-encryption recipient and state.
notes: The wallet builds the vp_token and the JARM claims (iss, aud from verified_request.client_id, iat, exp, vp_token, state) and encrypts them to jwk itself; the orchestrator only relays the JWE. Members are additive: a wallet that predates them answers with a vp_token, which the orchestrator refuses. verified_request.client_id is the JARM aud; verifier_jwk_thumbprint is the RFC 7638 SHA-256 thumbprint of response_encryption.jwk (Section 7.2).

description: Sign result of sign_presentation for direct_post.jwt: response_jwe and no vp_token.
notes: The orchestrator POSTs response=<jwe> (form-urlencoded) to the response_uri of verified_request and cannot decrypt the value. The jwe is a structurally valid test value, not decryptable.

description: Negative: sign result carrying both response_jwe and vp_token.
notes: A cleartext vp_token must not accompany the encrypted response; the orchestrator refuses it, fails the flow and answers the verifier access_denied with no detail.

description: Negative: sign result whose response_jwe is not a five-segment compact JWE.
notes: A value that is not a compact JWE is refused: the flow fails and the verifier is answered access_denied with no detail.

description: Sign result of sign_presentation: vp_token is a string.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: an accepted vp_token form.

description: Sign result of sign_presentation: vp_token is an array of strings.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: an accepted vp_token form.

description: Sign result of sign_presentation: vp_token is a DCQL object of query id to array of presentations.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: an accepted vp_token form.

description: Negative: vp_token is a boolean.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is a number.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is null.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is the empty string.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an empty array.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an array with a non-string entry.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an array with an empty-string entry.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an empty object.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an object with an empty array value.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an object with a string value instead of an array.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an object whose array holds a non-string.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: Negative: vp_token is an array that contains an array.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.4: a sign result whose vp_token is not a non-empty string, a non-empty array of non-empty strings, or a non-empty object of non-empty arrays of non-empty strings is refused; the value is not logged or echoed.

description: A wallet that did not offer transaction_data: the OID4VP flow ends -31005 with unsupported and the additive redirect_uri.
notes: Core Section 3.8.1, openid4x Section 2.3. unsupported is always present; redirect_uri only when the verifier's response mode produced a redirect. A wallet that only knows unsupported ignores redirect_uri. The orchestrator reported invalid_transaction_data to the verifier and did not drop the transaction data.

description: As above, when the verifier returned no redirect: data is exactly {"unsupported": "transaction_data"}.
notes: This vector assumes a verifier response that carried no redirect (a direct_post whose verifier answered without redirect_uri). When the verifier does return a redirect, in any response mode, redirect_uri is added as in flow-oid4vp-transaction-data-unsupported; omission depends on whether the verifier actually returned one, not on the response mode.

description: A wallet declines the sign sub-flow: -31006 with data.reason rejected.

input.step: orchestrator ends the parent flow at once, without waiting for the sub-flow timeout

notes: openid4x Section 3.2.6. The verifier is told access_denied with the request's state and no error_description; message and other data of the sub-flow error are not forwarded.

description: After wmp.session.resume the responder re-sends the latest flow.progress of each active flow.

input.step: responder re-sends the latest progress of the active flow

notes: Core Sections 4.5.3 and 6.2.1: the latest progress per active (non-terminal) flow only, not the whole history. A flow that already ended is not re-announced by this rule. Over the HTTPS binding last_received_id is an event ID (Transport Section 4.5).

description: Local match: the wallet reports which of the verifier's query ids it can satisfy, plus an opaque handle.

input.step: orchestrator starts the match flow with the verifier's DCQL query
wallet answers with query ids and a handle only it understands

notes: openid4x Section 3.3. The start carries only verifier data. The result is a closed set: satisfiable, satisfiable_query_ids, selection_handle, code.

description: Local match: nothing satisfies the query; code is the whole reason.
notes: code is one of no_match, insufficient, error; required when satisfiable is false, absent otherwise. No free-text reason.

description: Live completion with all three secret members: the replayed copy drops them and lists them, sorted.
notes: input is the live notification, delivered only to the streaming connection (openid4x 3.1.4.2); expected_replay is what the retained copy yields on replay. credentials and credential_metadata are kept unchanged; redacted_members is exactly the omitted members in alphabetical order.

description: Only refresh_token present: only it is redacted.
notes: redacted_members lists exactly what was omitted: ["refresh_token"].

description: No secret member: the replay equals the live notification.
notes: redacted_members is absent when nothing was omitted, and the retained copy needs no separate live copy: live and replay are the same message.

description: A secret member whose name is written with a JSON escape is still the secret member.
notes: In the vector file the name appears as "refresh\u005ftoken". After decoding it is refresh_token; an implementation that matches the raw bytes of the name would leak it. The replay is the same as for the unescaped form.

description: redacted_members names a member that is not a secret member (credential_metadata).
notes: openid4x 3.1.4.2: redacted_members lists exactly the secret members that were omitted, alphabetically, once each, and is absent when nothing was omitted. A client refuses a replayed completion that breaks this.

description: redacted_members lists a member twice.
notes: openid4x 3.1.4.2: redacted_members lists exactly the secret members that were omitted, alphabetically, once each, and is absent when nothing was omitted. A client refuses a replayed completion that breaks this.

description: redacted_members is present but empty.
notes: openid4x 3.1.4.2: redacted_members lists exactly the secret members that were omitted, alphabetically, once each, and is absent when nothing was omitted. A client refuses a replayed completion that breaks this.

description: A match result carrying a claim value.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: A match result listing the claim names a credential has.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: A match result carrying SD-JWT disclosures.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: A match result carrying a credential.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: The legacy matches[] shape: credential_id, vct and format per match.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: credential_id, vct and format as members of the result.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: The issuer of the matched credential.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: A free-text reason member.

result.no_match_reason: No credential of type urn:eudi:pid:1 for Svensson

notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: code is not one of the listed values (free text in the enum member).
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: code present although satisfiable is true.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: satisfiable is false and code is absent.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: satisfiable_query_ids elements are objects.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: Any member outside the closed set, however harmless-looking.
notes: openid4x Section 3.3.3: the orchestrator refuses this result: it ends the parent oid4vp flow with wmp.flow.error -32602 and does not log or store the offending members.

description: select_credentials: the user consents; one selection names the verifier's query id and the match handle.
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.3.1. The params are a closed set: consent and selections of {query_id, selection_handle}. The orchestrator learns neither the credential nor the claims; the wallet bounds disclosure by the verifier's query.

description: select_credentials: the user declines; consent false and no selections.
notes: selections is absent or empty when consent is false. The orchestrator ends the flow as for a declined user (Section 3.2.6) and starts no sign_presentation sub-flow.

description: Negative: a selection carries credential_id (the old shape).
notes: openid4x Section 3.2.3.1: which credential the user chose never reaches the orchestrator. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: the pre-redesign shape, credential_id plus disclosed_claims in a selection and no query_id or handle.
notes: Breaking change from earlier drafts: senders of the old shape are refused. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection carries disclosed_claims.
notes: Claim names do not reach the orchestrator. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection carries vct.
notes: No credential type information in a selection. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection carries a credential format.
notes: No credential format in a selection. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection carries claim values.
notes: No claim value at any depth. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection carries free text.
notes: No free text. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: an unknown member in a selection.
notes: Closed set: the ignore-unknown-members rule of Core Section 9.5 does not apply. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: an unknown member in the params.
notes: Closed set at the params level. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection without selection_handle.
notes: Both members of a selection are required. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a selection without query_id.
notes: Both members of a selection are required. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle shorter than 22 characters (128 bits).
notes: Handle format as in match-result.json. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle with base64 padding.
notes: Unpadded base64url only. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle with a character outside the base64url alphabet.
notes: Base64url alphabet only. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle of 25 characters, impossible for unpadded base64url.
notes: Length 1 mod 4 cannot occur. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle that is not a string.
notes: Type check. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: consent as a string.
notes: consent is a boolean. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: consent absent.
notes: consent is required. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: consent true with no selections.
notes: Consent to nothing is not consent. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: consent false with selections.
notes: A declined request carries no selections. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: query_id containing whitespace.
notes: A query id has no whitespace or control characters (DCQL ids are alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen; Presentation Exchange descriptor ids are arbitrary strings). That a well-formed query_id occurs in the verifier's query, and is not repeated, is checked by the orchestrator, not by the schema. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params, reports access_denied to the verifier, and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a handle followed by a line terminator.
notes: The alphabet check covers the whole string; a trailing newline is not base64url. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by answering the action request with a correlated JSON-RPC error -32602 without data, and ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params; it reports access_denied to the verifier and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Negative: a query_id followed by a line terminator.
notes: The id check covers the whole string. A conforming orchestrator refuses it by answering the action request with a correlated JSON-RPC error -32602 without data, and ending the parent oid4vp flow with a terminal wmp.flow.error code -32602 whose data echoes nothing of the params; it reports access_denied to the verifier and does not log, store or forward the offending members.

description: Wallet starts a credential_notification flow after the oid4vci flow flow-vci-001 completed (OpenID4x 3.4.1).
notes: The orchestrator validates params, finds the retained context and runs the flow. Requires the credential_notification capability.

description: Orchestrator asks the wallet for the DPoP proof of the notification request with a sign sub-flow of the notification flow (OpenID4x 3.4.3).
notes: The wallet completes with a non-empty dpop_proof. It refuses a sign_client_auth whose parent_flow_id is not a credential_notification flow it started.

description: Terminal result of a forwarded notification.
notes: A notification: no response.

description: Terminal error of a credential_notification flow: context_unavailable.
notes: No issuer or wallet text in message or data.

description: Terminal error of a credential_notification flow: busy.
notes: No issuer or wallet text in message or data.

description: Terminal error of a credential_notification flow: signing_failed.
notes: No issuer or wallet text in message or data.

description: Terminal error of a credential_notification flow: forward_failed.
notes: No issuer or wallet text in message or data.

description: A start whose event the orchestrator does not offer is refused with -32602 naming the member.
notes: data names the member and echoes no value.

description: A start without notification_id is refused with -32602.
notes: data names the member.

description: A start in a session that did not negotiate credential_notification is -31005.
notes: Core 3.8.1.
